gui.jaymoskingdoms.followers.title: Orders
gui.jaymoskingdoms.followers.order.1.des: They keep where they stand, meet any monster that comes close, then walk back.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.followers.order.2.des: They stay put and start nothing.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.followers.order.3.des: They walk a round about this spot and meet monsters on the way.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.followers.order.4.des: They hunt every monster about this spot, then hold it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.followers.order.5.des: They follow, and go for whatever you strike or whatever strikes you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.followers.none: Nobody near takes orders from you.
